question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: The Maldives is a small island country in the Indian Ocean made up of 1199 islands grouped into 26 (a) -------. These coral-based islands are known for their beauty and are a top tourist destination for their beaches, lagoons, and (b) ------- weather. With an area of only 300 square kilometres, it is the smallest country in Asia by size and population. Historically, people from India, Sri Lanka, East Africa, and Arabia came to these islands, and by the 12th century, the people had converted to (c) --- ---- Islam. Though ruled by the Portuguese and later by the British, the Maldives became a republic in 1968. Today, the Maldives faces a serious threat from rising (d) ------- levels due to global warming. To raise awareness, the government held the world’s first underwater (e) ------- meeting in 2009. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) atolls; (b) pleasant; (c) Sunni; (d) sea; (e) cabinet; ● ●
